additional_info.subject: RE: ID0405858-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / S5 170003680] Hard & Soft reset not worked CRM:00797001716
additional_info.body:
Dear Jordy Keimes,
Thank you for your time and patience.
Following our analysis of the logs, we have observed the following sequence of events:
The charger underwent a
hard reboot
at 2025-02-11T07:05:26, successfully processed the reboot, and was back online on OCPP at 2025-02-11T07:09:42.
Upon coming online, the charger remained in the
"Startup Test"
phase. Shortly after, at 2025-02-11T07:09:57, the charger received a
soft reboot command
from the OCPP backend.
It appears that the reset commands are being sent immediately after the charger reconnects to OCPP, resulting in it being rebooted before completing the necessary startup tests.
We recommend allowing a brief delay after the charger is back online to ensure it has sufficient time to complete the
startup test
process before initiating any reset commands. This will help prevent unnecessary reboots during the initialization phase.
Please let us know if you require further clarification or assistance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon

additional_info.subject: Log Analysis of 12th Feb 15:30 to 16:30 UTC
additional_info.body:
First hard reset from the OCPP backend was accepted by the charger, but it seems the main breaker wasn’t turned on after the reboot, causing Fast Shutdown and grouping to fail.
2025-02-12T15:47:27.355755+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/44e5d31a9326[636]: OCPP: Received command: Reset (213a3e92-3fa7-4091-9663-84520ad46e16) -
{"type":"Hard"}
025-02-12T15:50:49.297122+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [CGR] OperationMode
"SWITCH_MAIN_BREAKER_ON"" --> "ERROR"t
In the second attempt of the hard reset from the OCPP backend, the main breaker was turned on, the charger reached the next stage, and successfully rebooted with no errors.
2025-02-12T16:06:18.527410+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/44e5d31a9326[666]: OCPP: Received command: Reset (acfa7607-5e19-42b5-b8f3-a8b8f039fdeb) -
{"type":"Hard"}
2025-02-12T16:11:55.097854+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [CGR] OperationMode
"SWITCH_MAIN_BREAKER_ON"" --> "REQUEST CONVERTER SERIALNUMBERS"

additional_info.subject: Log analysis: 11th Feb, from 07:00 to 08:00
additional_info.body:
On 11th Feb, from 07:00 to 08:00, after a reboot from the OCPP backend, it seems the main breaker was not turned on. The customer sent the reset command four times consecutively, but the charger did not become healthy, as the logs show the main breaker was not turned on.
2025-02-11T07:05:26.584963+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/44e5d31a9326[674]: OCPP: Received command: Reset (19a35552-3a47-43f7-928b-df3863011cd8) -
{"type":"Hard"}
2025-02-11T07:08:48.943153+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [CGR] OperationMode
"SWITCH_MAIN_BREAKER_ON"" --> "ERROR"
2025-02-11T07:09:57.707836+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/44e5d31a9326[673]: OCPP: Received command: Reset (c0e52433-fdbb-4331-a0b9-a61533b0e99b) -
{"type":"Soft"}
2025-02-11T07:13:20.416063+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [CGR] OperationMode
"SWITCH_MAIN_BREAKER_ON"" --> "ERROR"
2025-02-11T07:17:48.229184+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/44e5d31a9326[678]: OCPP: Received command: Reset (fe351c5d-c8f4-42e9-8f60-a1122772faad) -
{"type":"Hard"}
2025-02-11T07:21:10.422544+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [CGR] OperationMode
"SWITCH_MAIN_BREAKER_ON"" --> "ERROR"
2025-02-11T07:28:26.232057+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/44e5d31a9326[668]: OCPP: Received command: Reset (69536dfb-18d8-4810-8307-551931128e42) -
{"type":"Soft"}
2025-02-11T07:31:50.360911+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [CGR] OperationMode
"SWITCH_MAIN_BREAKER_ON"" --> "ERROR"
2025-02-11T07:37:51.030124+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [CRS] Reboot command ... received from ISAR >>
Physical Power cycle
2025-02-11T07:43:09.374477+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [CGR] OperationMode
"SWITCH_MAIN_BREAKER_ON"" --> “ERROR”

After a physical power cycle, the main breaker was turned on, and the charger became healthy. The logs are attached for reference.

additional_info.subject: Note to L2
additional_info.body:
Issue:
The Si-D 400 kW charger did not become healthy after both soft and hard resets from the OCPP backend.
Analysis:
After rebooting the charger from the OCPP backend, the logs indicate that the main breaker was not turning on. Detailed logs for the 11th and 12th of February are attached. Please review the summary in the notes.
Next Steps:
Check the issue with the ES team and address it.
Additionally, the charger is currently running on FW v4.0.11. We have requested an update to the latest version, so please proceed based on customer feedback.
